_comment: Game titles in 'games' arrays MUST match the 'title' column in the games table exactly (e.g. 'X/Y', 'Sword/Shield', 'Scarlet/Violet'). These combined-version strings are taken from seeds/hunt_methods.json and cmd/seed_availability/main.go. If a title is unrecognised the seeder logs a warning and skips — reconcile against the live games table before relying on a complete seed. Only list a (pokemon_id, game) pair where the shiny is genuinely locked in THAT game; never list a game where the shiny is obtainable via soft-reset or normal hunting.
